view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Red metal shelves on the right hold stacked cardboard boxes. A blue and yellow safety barrier stands center-left. A gray SUV is parked near the left wall. A blue pallet jack rests beside the shelves. Lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling.

objects.label: gray SUV
objects.observation: A gray SUV is parked near the left wall, partially obscured by a blue safety barrier. It faces forward, with its front bumper and headlights visible. The vehicle is stationary on the concrete floor, with no visible contact with other objects except the ground.

objects.label: blue and yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: A tall blue metal frame with yellow base rails and mesh panels stands in the center-left of the image. It has a yellow sign with black letters 'AA UI' attached to it. The barrier is freestanding on the concrete floor, blocking access to an area behind it.

objects.label: red metal shelves
objects.observation: Tall red metal shelving units occupy the right side of the frame, filled with stacked cardboard boxes on wooden pallets. The shelves extend upward out of view. They are supported by vertical posts and appear to be bolted to the floor or anchored to the wall.

objects.label: blue pallet jack
objects.observation: A blue manual pallet jack is positioned on the floor next to the red shelves. It has wheels and a handle for pushing. The jack is resting against the shelf structure, suggesting it may have been used to move items onto the shelves.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes are stacked on wooden pallets on the red shelves. Some boxes are labeled with white tags. They are arranged in rows across multiple shelves, occupying most of the visible shelf space.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36383", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
